Five weeks of work since 3.138.0. ZangbandTK can draw the map
isometrically, the mouse works on the map, there are two new tile sets and a
redrawn third, and every character portrait is a new picture. The game is
faster in every build, and the Nintendo DS build plays on a real DS.

## Which download do I want?

| You have | ZangbandTK | Zangband |
|---|---|---|
| A Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or later) | `ZangbandTK-3.139.0-osx-tk.dmg` | `Zangband-3.139.0-osx.dmg` |
| A Mac with an Intel processor | no build, sorry | `Zangband-3.139.0-osx-intel.dmg` |
| Windows, 64-bit | `ZangbandTK-3.139.0-win64-tk.zip` | `Zangband-3.139.0-win64.zip` |
| Windows, 32-bit | | `Zangband-3.139.0-win32.zip` |
| Linux, x86-64 | `ZangbandTK-3.139.0-linux64-tk.AppImage` | `Zangband-3.139.0-linux64.AppImage` |
| Linux, 64-bit ARM | `ZangbandTK-3.139.0-linux64-tk-arm.AppImage` | `Zangband-3.139.0-linux64-arm.AppImage` |

ZangbandTK is the game in windows, modelled on ZangbandTk from the late
1990s, with a menu bar for every command. Zangband is the same game in the
classic layout. They're built from the same source and share your characters.

Zangband also comes as a terminal build for the Mac
(`-osx-terminal.tar.gz`, `-osx-terminal-intel.tar.gz`) and for Linux
(`-linux64-terminal.tar.gz`, `-linux64-terminal-arm.tar.gz`), for DOS
(`-dos.zip`) and for the Nintendo DS and 3DS (`-nintendo.zip`).
`ZangbandTK-3.139.0.tar.gz` is the source for all of them. You can also play
in a browser at [zangbandtk.com/play](https://zangbandtk.com/play/), with
nothing to download.

The Linux downloads run on glibc 2.27 or newer: Ubuntu 18.04, Debian 10,
RHEL 8 and anything after them.

## Opening it the first time

Neither application is signed with a paid developer certificate, so your
computer will stop the first launch.

- On a Mac, macOS says it can't verify the application. Try to open it once,
  click *Done*, then open System Settings, Privacy & Security, and click
  *Open Anyway* near the bottom.
- On Windows, SmartScreen stops it. Click *More info*, then *Run anyway*.
- On Linux, make the AppImage executable with `chmod +x` and run it.

If you're coming from 3.121.0 or earlier on a Mac, the application names
swapped in 3.128.1: the old ZangbandTK.app is Zangband.app now. The
[download page](https://zangbandtk.com/download.html) explains, and your
characters in `Documents/ZangbandTK` are safe either way.

## What's new since 3.138.0

- **An isometric map** in ZangbandTK, as ZAngbandTk 2.4 had: Display page,
  *Map view*. Four styles, from pen and ink to a dungeon in colour, plus one
  that stands the text map up. The art is new.
- **The mouse on the map.** ZangbandTK says what's under the pointer, a click
  steps towards it and a double click walks there.
- **New tiles.** The 1982 set (graphics mode 9), early-80s pixel art with a
  picture for everything in the game; David Gervais' 2001 sheets (mode 10),
  whose banks, roads and roofs join up in ZangbandTK; and Neon (modes 7 and 8)
  redrawn at 32×32.
- **New portraits.** All 784, every race and class as a man and as a woman,
  drawn at 64×64.
- **Faster.** Release builds use link-time optimisation, and the game, ZangbandTK
  and Zangband.app all do much less work per step.
- More of ZangbandTK in windows of its own: ignoring and auto-inscription, a
  running total in the Store window, deleting savefiles from Choose Game, and
  five bundled monospaced fonts.
- The Nintendo DS build plays on an original DS with the 8 MB Memory Expansion
  Pak, which it now needs.
- A [command reference card](https://zangbandtk.com/zangbandtk-command-card.pdf)
  to print: every key, in both keysets, on two sides of A4.
- Among the fixes: lava lit only half the squares round it, a road walked at
  night could vanish from the map, and browsing a book of a realm you don't
  study could crash the game.

The [release log](https://zangbandtk.com/releases.html) has the rest.

## Changes to the downloads

- ZangbandTK for Windows builds its own SDL2 and SDL2_mixer now, as Linux
  does. MP3, Ogg, Opus and FLAC are decoded inside SDL2_mixer.dll, and the
  separate codec DLLs, mpg123 among them, are gone. Music of your own in MOD,
  MIDI or WavPack no longer plays on Windows.
- The game's version number stood still at 3.138.0 through all of this work,
  so a build made between the two releases calls itself 3.138.0. This is the
  first release to say 3.139.0.

## Known gaps

- ZangbandTK has been played a good deal on the Mac. On Windows and Linux it's
  tested by script on every change and checked to start from its own download,
  but nobody has played a game through on either yet. If something goes
  wrong, please [open an issue](https://github.com/z88kat/ZangbandTK/issues).
- There is no Intel Mac build of ZangbandTK, and there won't be one.
- On the DS, the townspeople jump about at every step.
- A character saved before 3.73.0 loads with some of what it knew about
  object kinds attached to the wrong ones. Characters saved from 3.73.0 on are
  fine.
